note: The grass audit's missing species (docs/plant-data/grass-audit.md), in four batches: 'add-first', the twelve of the 'Add first' table, added in 0.9.91, 'europe', the ten of 'Europe and design grasses', added in 0.9.92, 'worth-adding', the twelve of 'Worth adding next', added in 0.9.130, and 'decided', giant miscanthus from 'Decide before adding', added with them. The cultivars list ends in batch 'cultivars' (0.9.131), the audit's 'Missing cultivars' table: seventeen choices on the species they belong to, with the Molinia subsp. caerulea selections on the species record, the tall subsp. arundinacea ones on 'Transparent', which draws them, and the two feather reed grass sports on 'Karl Foerster'. Each row is the record as written, its sources, and where the sources disagree, what was chosen and why. Hoffman's figures come from its catalog listing at https://hoffmannursery.com/plants, read through a browser because the site refuses a plain fetch. RHS hardiness ratings are the RHS's own scale (H4 is -10 to -5 C, H5 -15 to -10, H6 -20 to -15, H7 below -20) and are not USDA zones; a European nursery gives no USDA zone at all, so the zones in the European batch lean on US nurseries. Colours are authored throughout. The 'switchgrass' list (0.9.181) reviews every Panicum virgatum choice against MBG, NVK, Chicago Botanic Garden's trial and the 'Purple Tears' patent: sizes, colours and the drawing, when switchgrass was redrawn as leafy culms under the smoke cloud.

estimates.look: MBG: medium green leaves, yellow with orange tints in fall, tan-beige in winter; pink-tinged panicles turning beige. NVK: reddish-pink panicles changing to tan. Habit and leaves, all switchgrasses: a clump of leafy culms, each with a leaf at every node, held upright and bowing at the tip (MBG: 'stiff, columnar form'; NVK: 'flat leaf blades ... branching from upright stems'; the 'Purple Tears' patent: about 45 leaves on a flowering culm, 25 cm blades). Panicle: an open airy panicle above the leaves, about 10 lateral branches up to 15 cm with secondary branches, about 130 small awnless spikelets each 5 x 2 mm on 4 mm pedicels (the patent), 'pink-tinged ... like an airy cloud', beige in fall (MBG). Foliage-to-flower height from NVK's two figures sets leafLen and panBase.
